tasks.title: Announcement #57
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university event.
tasks.transcript: Attention everyone. We are pleased to announce that the university's annual drama festival will be held next Friday at 6 p.m. in the auditorium. There will be performances by various student groups. We hope to see you there.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：We are pleased to announce that the university's annual drama festival will be held next Friday at 6 p.m. in the auditorium. 选项分析： A. A student meeting 一次学生会议。公告中未提及会议，所以A选项错误。 B. A theater workshop 一次戏剧工作坊。公告中未提及工作坊，所以B选项错误。 C. An upcoming drama festival event 一场即将到来的戏剧节活动。公告明确宣布年度戏剧节的时间地点，所以C选项正确。 D. A new drama course 一门新的戏剧课程。公告中未提及课程，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker hope the listeners will do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：说话者希望听众做什么？ 定位原文：We hope to see you there. 选项分析： A. Submit their scripts 提交他们的剧本。公告中未提及提交剧本，所以A选项错误。 B. Join a theater group 加入一个戏剧团体。公告中未提及加入团体，所以B选项错误。 C. Prepare for a performance 为演出做准备。公告中未要求听众做准备，所以C选项错误。 D. Attend the festival 参加戏剧节。说话者说“希望在那里见到你”，即希望听众到场参加戏剧节，所以D选项正确。
